title: Chinese Face Solo #32 (중국 · 아이돌 · 도도한 · 메이크업 잉크 블랙립(강화) · 마이크로더멀 골드 라운드 · 스티커 이마 눈 · 렌즈 앰버(큰 동공))
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and the tops of her collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Early 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Chinese woman — Chinese pop idol visual luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, early 20s, hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum, a sleek high ponytail with wispy side bangs. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, a soft sheen of natural oils, large eyes with bright real catchlights, full lips, extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a blurred ink-black gradient across the lids like soft smoke, a fine black liner, natural full lashes, a glass-skin highlight on the cheekbones, ink-black glossy lips with a softly blurred gradient edge, vivid glowing amber-gold coloured contact lenses with a greatly enlarged dilated pupil, both eyes the same, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, microdermal gold round faceted gems pressed deep into the skin: a row of five small gems along each cheekbone, each gem sitting on a tiny hidden metal base implanted beneath the skin and pressing firmly down so the skin around every gem is visibly pushed in, forming a clear small dimple with a soft raised ring of flesh bulging around its edge, a small natural warm shadow in each dimple, calm healthy skin with no redness or swelling, all gems well clear of the eyes, a single small evil-eye sticker at the center of the forehead, well above the brows, all stickers flat on the skin, clear of the eyes and lids, looking down along the nose with the chin lifted slightly, lips closed in a faint haughty line, an aloof, haughty expression — a photograph of a real Chinese woman's face (East Asian Chinese features: a longer oval face with prominent high cheekbones and a defined jawline, long upturned phoenix-shaped eyes with sharp inner folds, a high strong nose bridge, thin arched eyebrows with a slight rise, balanced lips), not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light 

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the gems catch the light; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
